key_facts: For the selected CASE CX130 catalog (North America, production range 04/00–12/08), the inspected 09-51 ESCO bucket assembly lists bucket tooth part 127558A1, catalog quantity 4–6, callout 5; its matching adapter is 127557A1, quantity 4–6. Observed in assembly 09-51 - BUCKETS - ESCO (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/368E796F-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

A second inspected ESCO bucket configuration, assembly 09-52, lists bucket tooth 233794A1, quantity 4–5, callout 5, with adapter 233793A1, quantity 4–5. This configuration also includes a shroud kit 378649A1. Observed in assembly 09-52 - BUCKETS - ESCO (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/buckets-esco/cn/6F27767B-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

The inspected 09-51 and 09-52 assemblies describe different bucket capacities and tooth counts; the catalog does not establish that 127558A1 and 233794A1 are interchangeable. Confirm bucket configuration, capacity, and PIN before ordering.

A third inspected ESCO bucket assembly, 09-53, lists bucket capacities 0.65 and 0.73 cu m but does not list a bucket tooth or adapter occurrence; it only lists adjustment hardware. The supplied dated catalog snapshot does not establish a single universal tooth for all CX130 buckets.

Evidence was observed 2026-11-04. Machine discovery is a partial dated snapshot, while the host reports the local 306-assembly directory as complete; assembly-source completeness is otherwise unspecified. Catalog quantities are not stock quantities.
